summary: Anyscale's AI Startup Program grants eligible startups up to $20K in Anyscale usage credits that run on the startup's own cloud and stack with existing cloud provider credits, plus dedicated field-engineer support for architecture and hands-on technical help. The application is reviewed on cloud spend/credits and stage; a separate $100 signup credit is advertised via the 'Get Started with $100 Credit' nav link.
claim_steps: Open the Anyscale Startup Program page and submit the application (review considers cloud spend/credits and stage).
For the separate $100 signup credit, click 'Get Started with $100 Credit' in the nav, which links to Anyscale's auth/signup flow.

social_proof.title: Anyscale AI Startup Program
social_proof.text: Access up to $20K in Anyscale credits. Run on your own cloud and stack these with your existing cloud provider credits. Dedicated Field Engineers to support application architecture design and hands-on technical support.
